params.name: ids
params.description: Filter alerts based on ID of the alert [Plerion Resource Names (prn)]. Accepts a comma-separated list of ids.

params.name: workflowIds
params.description: Filter alerts based on Plerion Workflow IDs. Accepts a comma-separated list of workflow ids.

params.name: integrationIds
params.description: Filter alerts based on Plerion integration ids. Accepts a comma-separated list of integration ids.

params.name: assetGroupIds
params.description: Filter alerts based on asset group ids. Accepts a comma-separated list of asset group ids.

params.name: statuses
params.description: Filter alerts based on statuses. Accepts a comma-separated list of statuses.

params.name: resourceTypes
params.description: Filter alerts based on provider resource types. Accepts a comma-separated list of resource types.

params.name: providers
params.description: Filter alerts based on provider. Accepts a comma-separated list of providers.

params.name: alertTypes
params.description: Filter alerts based on alert type. Accepts a comma-separated list of type.

params.name: flagged
params.description: Filter alerts based on flag status. Accepts a single value. The supported values are `true` or `false`.

params.name: acknowledged
params.description: Filter alerts based on acknowledge status. Accepts a single value. The supported values are `true` or `false`.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Order the list by supported field

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order of the list. The parameter sortBy has to be provided to use sortOrder. If sortOrder is not provided the default order is `ASC`.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Get the next batch of alerts. Used for pagination.

params.name: perPage
params.description: Specify the batch size of the list. Used for pagination

items.docs: Use the list alerts API to get alerts for the tenant.
